sources.title: Ouro: Looped Language Models
sources.snippet: Ouro uses a parameter-shared looped architecture where the same transformer blocks are applied recurrently. This allows the model to perform iterative computation in latent space, enabling deeper reasoning without proportionally increasing parameter count.
